To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the supplier integration approach has a positive effect on new product development performance; 2) the effect is stronger for projects that have a higher degree of uncertainty; 3) the effect is weaker for projects with a higher degree of complexity; 4) the effect is strongest when the supplier is integrated in a decoupled way.

(i) the integration of suppliers in new product development is a complex process that involves many different aspects and activities; and (ii) the integration of supplier knowledge can be done by using a decoupled or coupled approach.

(1) The use of a decoupled approach to integrate supplier knowledge into new product development projects has the potential to improve the quality of the new product development process and the quality of the product, (2) The use of coupled approach to integrate supplier knowledges into new product development process is more effective than the decoupled approach.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how to integrate supplier knowledge in new Product development (NPD) projects.
the integration of suppliers into new product development (NPD) projects and how the integration of supplier knowledge into the NPD project affects the NPD project outcome.
understanding the nature of supplier knowledge integration in new product development (NPD) projects and how this is related to NPD performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the integration of suppliers in new product development (NPD) projects has a significant effect on the performance of these projects, and that the degree of integration of suppliers is an important moderator in this relationship.
the decoupled and the coupled approaches are both valid and useful in new product development.

a supplier knowledge integration approach should be chosen based on the specific project characteristics, and that the choice of approach should also take the specific supplier relationship characteristics into account.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the decoupled and the coupled approaches are two different ways of integrating supplier knowledge in new-product development projects.
we have shown how the supplier can contribute to the new product development process.
our findings indicate that the supplier's knowledge is a critical success factor in new product development.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is no one best way to integrate supplier knowledge.
the knowledge integration process can be decoupled from the new product development project and can be performed in advance of the project, which is more efficient.
the decoupling of supplier knowledge integration (SKI) and new product development (NPD) project management is a viable approach for firms that have limited internal capabilities to manage SKI.
